rec.name: Benefit Slider with Icon Tabs and Description
rec.status: Built — preview delivered, ticket closed without customer feedback

what.text: A compact benefit slider section. It shows three benefit tabs, each with a round green icon and a bold short label (e.g. 'Risk-free', '10,000+ reviews', 'Premium quality'). Under the tabs sits a segmented progress bar, with the active segment highlighted in the brand colour. Below the bar is a one- or two-sentence explanation for the active benefit (e.g. 'Thanks to the 30-day money-back guarantee you can try any product without commitment'). It was ordered as a 'Benefit section like Hundpur' (a reference store) and built by customising the existing 'Store Benefits' slider section.

why.text: It puts the key reassurances (risk reversal, social proof, quality) in one scannable spot near the buying decision. Icons and short labels are quick to process. The expandable description answers the main objection, 'what if it doesn't work for me?', with a concrete guarantee. The '10,000+ reviews' tab adds a social proof cue. The slider and progress bar invite interaction without taking much vertical space on mobile.

how.text: Start from the theme's existing 'Store Benefits' slider section. Configure 3 or more slides, each with an icon, a bold title and a description. Style the icons as circles in the brand colour. Show a segmented progress or tab indicator under the titles, with the active segment in the brand colour and the rest in light grey. Place the section on the product page, e.g. below the buy box or the gallery. Developers customised the existing section instead of building from scratch, so expect small styling tweaks (colours, corners, spacing) per brand.

items: Icon circle colour (brand green in the reference)
Active and inactive progress bar colours
Number of slides (3 in the reference)

dependencies.text: Needs an existing slider-type section in the theme (here 'Store Benefits' in the Sectionfy theme 'nour-de-la-lune/main'). No metafields or apps were mentioned, so content is assumed to be set in the theme editor. The ticket also bundled five other Sectionfy sections that are only linked, not described here.

items: Slider interaction rate (tab clicks and swipes)

images.caption: Reference design: three round green icons with bold labels, a segmented progress bar with the active segment in green, and the benefit description below.
